title: Rory and the Hill of Silver Ferns
verses:
The sun drifted down past the edge of the hill,
The forest was misty and deep,
The evening grew cozy and wonderfully still,
As Rory was ready to sleep.

Now Benny stepped softly across the cool ground,
While Tilly came ambling near,
They walked side by side without making a sound,
Where blossoms were fragrant and clear.

Then Ricky slowed down on a carpet of green,
To curl near a hollow of bark,
While Psittaco nestled where shadows were seen,
To tuck in his wings in the dark.

High over the treetops did Nia take flight,
She guided the breeze from the skies,
And swooped through the air in the silvery light,
As tiredness fell on their eyes.

The ferns made a blanket so tender and wide,
Where Rory lay down with a sigh,
The friends tucked together right close by his side,
Beneath the great dome of the sky.

The stars twinkle gently on valley and crest,
While soft little lullabies play,
The dinosaurs drift in their magical rest,
To wake to a sunny new day.
